answers.how: The car's fitted pixel acceleration is about 64 px/s², giving 16 px/m. The pedestrian moves about 19.2 px/s near 1.0 s, so its speed is 19.2/16.
The car is about 35 pixels wide. Using 16 px/m from its acceleration gives 35/16 ≈ 2.2 m.
The car is about 93.6 pixels long. Using 16 px/m from its acceleration gives 93.6/16 = 5.85 m.
